name: QuickOnwardTicket
description: Travel service that issues real, verifiable airline reservations (genuine PNRs) travelers use as proof of onward travel for visa applications and border checks. Its affiliate program pays creators and publishers 25% of every referred sale, tracked over a 60-day cookie, with monthly PayPal/bank payouts from a $50 minimum.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page: 25% commission on every referred sale, 60-day cookie window, $50 minimum payout, monthly payouts via PayPal/bank, free to join with quick approval. UNCAPPED verbatim — FAQ 'How much can I earn?': 'You earn 25% of the sale value on every booking made through your referral link. There's no cap — the more you refer, the more you earn.'

Page explicitly targets travel bloggers, digital-nomad communities, visa consultants, travel agencies, YouTubers & creators and community admins; application is by email with a short note about your audience or channel (the page's published contact email was masked in the fetched text, so no address is recorded).

reasons.niche_fit: Pure travel utility — proof of onward travel is a recurring need for the exact audiences travel creators serve.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program page names YouTubers & creators, travel bloggers and communities as its target partners.
reasons.compensation: Published 25% of sale value AND verified uncapped on the brand's own page ('There's no cap').
reasons.contact_access: Application is by email from the program page; no readable public address could be captured, so none is recorded.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open, free application with quick approval; monthly payouts from a $50 threshold.
reasons.credibility: Small, newer service still describing an early-access phase for affiliate stats; product itself is verifiable (real PNRs).

name: Flightright
description: Air passenger rights service founded in 2010 that enforces EU261 compensation (up to £520 / €600) for delayed, cancelled or overbooked flights on a no-win-no-fee basis (success fee typically 20-30% plus VAT). Its affiliate programme on Awin pays a flat £20 CPA per lead/order with a 30-day cookie, and is active in Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

evidence.summary: Awin merchant profile (fetched): 'Commission: £20 CPA per Lead', 'A handsome CPA of £20 per order', 30-day cookie duration. Flat CPA bounty, so commission_rate is null and the £20 flat amount is recorded here. Accepted partner types include 'Content creators & influencers' and editorial content. Programme active in Germany, France and the United Kingdom.
Awin profile closes with 'For campaign questions: partner@flightright.de' from the Flightright Affiliate Team.

Profile states Flightright has enforced more than €700 million in compensation since 2010, achieves a 99% success rate in court, and is the market leader in air passenger rights; customer success fee typically 20%-30% plus VAT.

reasons.niche_fit: Flight disruption help is a core travel-creator topic; compensation amounts are concrete and content-friendly.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Awin profile lists content creators & influencers and communities/UGC among accepted partner types.
reasons.compensation: Flat £20 CPA per lead/order (recorded as a flat bounty, rate null) — strong per-action pay but not a % of sale; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Named affiliate team email (partner@flightright.de) published on the network profile.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin, limited to the DE/FR/UK programmes.
reasons.credibility: Market leader since 2010 with €700M+ enforced and a 99% court success rate, per its Awin profile.

name: WayAway
description: Travel metasearch service comparing flights, hotels, car rentals and attractions across hundreds of airlines and agencies, known for WayAway Plus, a paid membership that pays members real-money cashback on bookings. Its affiliate program runs on Travelpayouts: affiliates earn a revenue share on flight bookings plus a fixed bounty per WayAway Plus membership sold.

evidence.summary: Travelpayouts (the network hosting the program) states the WayAway partner program rates: flight ticket bookings pay 50% of the revenue share WayAway receives (website cookie 30 days; mobile app installs linked for 180 days), and WayAway Plus sales pay a fixed reward of $10 per sale of the $49.99 membership plan. Revenue-share basis, so commission_rate is null and the structure is recorded here.

UpPromote's affiliate directory confirms the program is run by Travelpayouts, is CPS/revenue-share plus a fixed rate per membership sale, with a 30-day website cookie and 180-day app attribution; flights average roughly 1.1% to 1.3% of ticket price to the affiliate via the 50% revenue share.
PhocusWire coverage: WayAway emerged from Travelpayouts; partners receive up to 50% of the income WayAway receives from airline ticket sales plus $10 per WayAway Plus membership sale.

reasons.niche_fit: Flight/hotel metasearch plus a cashback membership is squarely travel-creator territory.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program is marketed to travel content creators through Travelpayouts, with links, widgets, banners and promo codes.
reasons.compensation: 50% revenue share of WayAway's flight income (about 1.1-1.3% of ticket price) plus a flat $10 per Plus membership; no cap statement published, so cap is unknown and rate is null (revenue-share basis).
reasons.contact_access: No public program email found on the fetched sources; support runs through the Travelpayouts dashboard.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to join via a free Travelpayouts account; 30-day web cookie and 180-day app attribution.
reasons.credibility: Established metasearch brand from the Travelpayouts group, covered by PhocusWire.

name: Chicwish
description: Online women's fashion retailer known for feminine dresses, skirts, knitwear and occasion pieces, selling and shipping worldwide in USD with major markets in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and Asia. Its affiliate program pays 8% commission on referred sales with a 30-day tracking cookie and explicitly also works with fashion bloggers.

evidence.summary: Awin-hosted Chicwish program profile (fetched): '8% commission rate with $90 average order size (commission rate is the SAME if coupons are used and is the SAME for returning customers)', 30-day tracking cookie, datafeed and banners, dedicated program management, affiliates accepted from every country, and 'We also work with fashion bloggers'. The profile states tracking, sales and payments are handled by ShareASale, which is recorded as the network.
Shopper's directory lists the Chicwish program at a 5-10% payout range; the network profile's flat 8% is the authoritative figure recorded.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure women's fashion with strong dress/occasionwear content angles for fashion creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program profile explicitly says it works with fashion bloggers; banners and product feeds supplied.
reasons.compensation: Published flat 8% on all sales (same rate for coupon and returning-customer orders) on a $90 average order; no cap statement, so cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Dedicated program management via the network, but no public email on the fetched profile.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network application; affiliates accepted from every country.
reasons.credibility: Long-running global retailer with a detailed, current network program profile.

name: FlyClaim
description: Flight compensation service that pursues EU Regulation 261/2004 claims (up to €600 per passenger) for delayed, cancelled or disrupted flights on a success-fee basis. Its partner program pays affiliates 15% of FlyClaim's success fee on every referred claim that pays out, with 30-day tracking, monthly payouts and no minimum volume.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page (fetched): 'You keep 15% of our fee' — for every successful claim credited within the 30-day cookie window the partner receives 15% of FlyClaim's success fee, paid monthly; typical partner earnings €50+ per successful claim. Percentage-of-fee (revenue) basis, so commission_rate is null and the basis is recorded here. No contracts, no quotas, no minimum volume.

Page names creators first among who it suits ('Travel voices on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or in a newsletter'), plus publishers, travel tools and networks; application is a short form on the page, no website required.

reasons.niche_fit: Flight-delay compensation is a narrower travel niche than booking, but highly relevant to frequent-flyer audiences.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program page leads with creators on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube and supplies ready-to-use assets.
reasons.compensation: 15% of the service's success fee per paid claim (revenue basis, rate null), typically €50+ per claim; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Application form on the program page with a named partner contact promised after approval; no public email recorded.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application, no contract, no minimum volume, monthly payouts.
reasons.credibility: Smaller, newer claims service; terms are clearly published on its own page.

Its affiliate partner program pays a percentage of every sale and refill through a unique link, with a 30-day cookie and monthly PayPal payouts; the exact rate is agreed individually with each partner.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page (fetched): open to bloggers, travel agents, influencers and more; commission on every sale and refill, % of sale commission type, 30-day cookie, monthly payouts through PayPal, a personal affiliate manager, and a reader discount on SIM cards and hotspots.

reasons.compensation: Percentage-of-sale commission confirmed, but the rate is negotiated individually and not published (rate null); no cap statement, so cap is unknown.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up from the program page; $25 minimum payout, monthly PayPal.
reasons.credibility: Established travel-connectivity brand with detailed published program terms.
